title: ehrlich-b/euclidean-jordan
summary: The Jordan trace form tau(x,y) = tr(L_{x*y}), constructed from the multiplication rather than assumed: symmetric, associative, and positive definite. Symmetry and associativity need neither finite dimensionality nor formal reality; positive definiteness needs both, and runs through the spectral theorem. The carrier is not assumed unital, so this supplies the Euclidean form itself and does not by itself establish a unital Euclidean Jordan algebra. Sits directly on Mathlib's IsCommJordan. Coordinatization is absent. Machine checked, not peer reviewed, no priority claim.
